items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: Gucci has made unannounced, permanent price reductions across handbags, footwear and ready-to-wear (e.g. the crystal Padlock bag down 30% in France, sneakers down from EUR800 to EUR560-595). Kering frames this as a 'targeted correction' of overpriced items as part of Gucci's broader turnaround and 'perceived value' repositioning led by handbags.

items.title: Gucci discount strategy puts pressure on luxury rivals; Louis Vuitton isn't following
items.summary: Forbes analyzes Gucci's permanent price cuts as breaking an industry taboo on luxury discounting, noting rivals like Louis Vuitton are holding firm on pricing, which could reshape competitive dynamics across Asia's luxury markets including Southeast Asia.

items.title: Kering merosot saat penjualan Gucci turun 6% meski pendapatan Q3 sesuai ekspektasi
items.summary: Indonesian-language financial coverage of Kering's Q3 2026 results: Gucci comparable sales fell 6%, directly operated retail sales fell 9% as foot traffic weakened, especially in mainland China and Japan; Kering shares dropped on the report.

items.title: Penjualan Gucci makin menurun bikin Kering keteteran, efek Demna belum terasa
items.summary: Indonesian lifestyle-news outlet Detik/Wolipop reports that continued declines in Gucci sales are straining parent Kering, and that Demna's creative overhaul has not yet produced a visible sales turnaround, citing Q3 2026 results.

items.title: The Gucciness of Gucci takes over New York with Cruise 2027
items.summary: WWD's review/interview on Demna's Gucci Cruise 2027 show staged in Times Square, describing the 'GucciCore' concept as 90% wardrobe staples the brand was missing, blended with 10% fashion-forward pieces, as part of his ongoing turnaround narrative relevant to global (incl. SEA) retail assortment.

items.title: Fans are 'disappointed' over Mariah Carey's 'depressing' Gucci holiday campaign
items.summary: Report compiling social-media reaction to Gucci's Mariah Carey-fronted 2026 holiday campaign (directed by Harmony Korine). Many viewers called the ad 'boring,' 'cold' and 'outdated'; one comment compared it to 'JCPenney trying to be luxury,' though some praised Carey's styling.

items.title: Men's Folio Thailand roundup of Gucci Primavera FW2026 looks
items.summary: Thai fashion-media X account posts a roundup of key looks and moments from Gucci's Primavera (Fall/Winter 2026) show, Demna's runway debut, tagged with #GucciPrimavera and #MensFolioThailand for Thai-speaking fashion audience.

items.title: Vogue Thailand on Gucci 'The Store Show' concept
items.summary: Vogue Thailand's Thai-language X post describes Demna's Gucci runway staged as a store, with models walking as if shopping customers, debuting the menswear side of the collection; framed as breaking from runway convention.

items.title: GUCCI最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀+降价40%+关店105家
items.summary: Chinese-language Weibo explainer post summarizing Gucci's recent major news in three dimensions: Demna's debut collections, price cuts of up to 40% on some items, and 105 net store closures year-to-date, framed as an FAQ on the brand's repositioning.

items.title: Why Demna's Gucci took over Times Square (Resort 2027 Review)
items.summary: YouTube fashion-commentary video analyzing Demna's Gucci Cruise/Resort 2027 Times Square takeover, discussing the GucciCore concept and critical reception, viewed by general and SEA-reachable English-speaking fashion audiences.

items.title: Gucci Resort 2027 Review (YouTube Short)
items.summary: Short-form video reviewing Gucci's Resort/Cruise 2027 collection, part of general creator commentary circulating on social video platforms reachable by SEA audiences.

items.title: "BLM regret buying Gucci" thread on Lowyat Forum
items.summary: Malaysian tech/lifestyle community thread where a user expresses regret over a Gucci purchase, with forum replies discussing value-for-money and quality perceptions of the brand versus price paid; a Priority-A SEA community source per buzz registry.

items.title: หัวเข็มขัดกุชชี่แบบนี้ปกติมั้ยคะ (Is this Gucci belt buckle normal?)
items.summary: Older Thai Pantip thread where a user asks the community to verify whether a Gucci belt buckle design/finish is normal or defective; included only as evidence Pantip authenticity-check threads recur, but this specific thread is stale (old) and NOT counted toward freshness-weighted buzz.

items.title: Is Gucci Still Worth Buying in 2026? — resale value decline analysis
items.summary: Resale-guide site reports Michele-era Gucci pieces have lost 40-60% of retail value on the secondary market, worse than Hermes, Chanel or Louis Vuitton depreciation; flagged verification_required per tier policy and EXCLUDED from freshness-weighted pool (published August 2026, outside the 14-day window) — retained only as background context, not scored.
